use: Strict evidence-scoped NPC speech. A witnessed event is not an adjacent event at the same location. Distinguish negative witness from uncertain knowledge.

shiki.rain_genin.forest_encounter.limits: Ren personally witnessed the final Rain genin declare surrender while restrained; Aki did not personally witness the final kill. Do not give Aki the surrendered detail without report.

gaara.forest_death_actions.indirect_knowledge_possible: Arrival at the tower; hearsay; later testimony, if it actually occurs
gaara.forest_death_actions.limits: No member of Shiki's team watched Gaara fight or kill in the forest. Mere knowledge of 97-minute arrival or violent reputation does not make anyone an eyewitness.

gaara.hinata.prelim.limits: Ren personally watched Gaara injure Hinata and the official stoppage. He may draw inferences about Gaara's ability or brutality only from the arena bout.

gaara.shiki.cafeteria.limits: The question 'When you kill someone, do you feel you exist?' was Gaara speaking to Shiki; it is NOT a confession that Gaara himself only feels alive when killing. Infer with uncertainty.

mio.beam.rescue.limits: Neither Ren nor Aki saw the beam rescue; later reliable report must be explicit.

shiki.yoroi.medical_dialogue.limits: Kabuto saw Shiki go to the wing, not the content of his conversation with the surgeon; his guess remains conjecture.

corrected_historical_line.speaker: ren
corrected_historical_line.quote: Я видел, что этот Гаара сделал с Хинатой. И видел, что произошло в лесу.
corrected_historical_line.rejected_meaning: Ren personally saw Gaara fight in the Forest of Death
corrected_historical_line.permitted_meaning: Ren saw Gaara vs Hinata and separately witnessed Shiki vs Rain genin; do not blend these into personal observation of Gaara in forest.
corrected_historical_line.retcon_scope: Historical assistant text remains in chat source, but the implication about Gaara's forest battle is noncanonical. No invented new speech for Ren; future scenes use corrected knowledge.

require_check: Who personally observed exactly this event?
Is this event different from an adjacent one in the same forest, exam, or medical wing?
What is the referent of this/it/him/there/in the forest?
Does a reference to the previous conversation subject falsely imply witnessing a different event?
If indirect, identify who reported, when and with which wording; no report by inference alone.
If no source, phrase as speculation without fake eyewitness authority, or omit.
provenance: User OOC correction 'видел, что произошло в лесу. Нет не видел. Просачивание знаний. Протокол проверки просачивания усилить и сохранись' (2026-11-12).
